about: Self-test falsifiers for task 004: each entry breaks one check in examples/agent-host/falsify.py (exact text, replaced once), and every named self-test case must then FAIL. Run with: python3 -I examples/agent-host/falsify.py --list examples/agent-host/handoff/reports/falsifiers-004-selftest.json. These cases are pure load()/argv checks: no case calls main() and no case runs a list.
